title: Publisher listing: Marrow Lane Press
text: Marrow Lane Press has published poetry from Kelmore since 2009. It issues around six titles a year, most of them first collections, and runs the Kelmore Pamphlet Prize for poets without a full-length book. The press is run by two editors and reads unsolicited submissions in a single window each autumn.
